purpose: Strict, persistent import targets; entries only become public after original statement transcription and classification are verified. Do not substitute source URLs or blank strings for problem statements.

collections.competition: International Mathematics Competition for University Students
collections.identifier_rule: Official year, day and official problem number; preserve non-standard counts
Use original paper numbering; do not impose A1–B6 before 1985; retain distinct 1958 examinations; no invented events for 1943–1945

collections.competition: South Eastern European Mathematical Olympiad for University Students
collections.identifier_rule: Preserve original examination numbering and edition eligibility; verify actual held years
Keep official Category I/II attached to every problem; never merge same-number questions
Keep A/B/C paper identity per edition; do not assume all years had three papers

taxonomy.topics: Existing bank controlled topical classification (must never guess unknown category)
taxonomy.problem_dna: Use only IDs from metadata/problem-dna.json techniques; omit unsupported technique, never invent
taxonomy.mathematical_connections: Cross-links based on demonstrated mathematical equivalence, not similarity alone

safety_rules: Full statement text required; no placeholder or official PDF link as substitute
Publication basis must be documented before mirroring externally sourced protected texts
No unverified original year or problem count
